periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal, angled approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, extending from the medial canthus toward the pinnae.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with the vertical-oblique axis significantly longer than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the ventral-most point of the eye patch extending toward the lower facial boundary.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the superior cranial surface, approximately equivalent to the width of the forehead region.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish-brown staining on the white fur of the abdominal and lower ventral regions.
